content: States: Arizona, California, Idaho, Louisiana, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, Washington and Wisconsin. IRS Pub. 555, "Community Property" (https://www.irs.gov/publications/p555). Elective community property regimes (Alaska, Tennessee, South Dakota, Kentucky, Florida trusts) are not included.

Basis at the first death: both halves of community property take a basis equal to fair market value when at least half was included in the decedent's estate, IRC 1014(b)(6) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/1014). A qualified joint interest of spouses outside community property is half included in the decedent's estate, IRC 2040(b) (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/2040), so only that half steps up under IRC 1014(a), (b)(9).
